title: Kaboom
blurb: Kaboom is not what explosions actually sound like. It is what we have all collectively agreed they sound like, and for editing purposes that is considerably more useful. This one runs a full eleven seconds — sharp crack, deep body, then a long rolling tail that keeps going well after the picture has cut. The tail earns its keep by letting an edit breathe, so drop the blast on a cut and let the rumble carry into the next shot. Good for demolition gags, dramatic reveals and arguments that need a definite ending.
origin: A large explosion sound effect with a long rolling tail.
